subject: Arcwell: subprocessor roster & evidence delivery commitment
messages:
From: Amit Shah <security@arcwell.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor roster + SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Hi Ben,

As part of Arcwell's procurement security review we're collecting canonical third‑party rosters and SIG/CAIQ evidence for vendors that will process patient metadata. Please provide the following by EOD Friday (UTC):

1) A canonical subprocessor roster with residency (country/region) and purpose. CSV preferred.
2) A short SIG/CAIQ extract or map that points to where Redwood has provided answers for the controls that map to data residency, key management, export controls, and telemetry retention.
3) Copies of SOC 2 report (redacted) and any attestation letters for cloud infra providers you rely on.
4) Whether any onshore (US) / EU data localization controls exist for inference logs and KMS key residency, and whether customers can opt for on‑prem or bring‑your‑own‑keys.

We understand some items may be sensitive; if necessary, a link to a restricted drive or NDA can be used. If you can share a delivery ETA and a single point of contact for evidence handoff that would help our ingestion workflow.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Security Program Manager
Arcwell Health

Amit —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can get you a canonical roster and an abridged SIG/CAIQ mapping. Marissa will assemble the roster and the SIG extract; Grace will confirm KMS and residency language.

Preliminary ETA: draft roster + SIG extract by Thursday EOD PST, final artifacts (CSV + PDF), signed attestations or redacted SOC2 by Friday EOD UTC. If any item requires an NDA/secure link, we'll send a restricted Drive folder and a one‑time access token.

Point of contact for the handoff: marissa_cole@redwood.com (security evidence lead).

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subprocessor roster + SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Hi Amit —

See the attached initial package: a canonical roster CSV and an abridged SIG/CAIQ response PDF. Highlights below to speed your review: 

- Attached roster (redwood_subprocessor_roster.csv): lists vendors, function (e.g., telemetry storage, KMS, logging, CDN), country of residence, and whether access to customer data is possible. We flagged high‑risk entries (see column "risk_flag").
- SIG/CAIQ (redwood_sig_responses_abridged.pdf): callouts for 3 control families you asked about — Data Residency (CC7), Key Management (ENCRYPT), Export Controls, and Monitoring/Retention (LOGRET). The PDF includes answers and links to where full SIG responses live in our secure folder.
- SOC 2: We included a redacted SOC 2 cover page and a link to the full report under a restricted folder — sending access now.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_roster.csv (text/csv), redwood_sig_responses_abridged.pdf (application/pdf)
Drive link (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-Arcwell-evidence — I granted access to security@arcwell.com.

Short answers to your residency/KMS questions: 
- KMS residency: Customers on Redwood Dedicated or Private can control key residency via their KMS provider. For Hosted accounts we offer optional CMK envelope wrappers and an upcoming BYOK flow; keys used for control plane metadata are stored in our managed KMS (US), but customer data keys can be provisioned in-region on Dedicated/Private.
- Inference logs/telemetry: By default, short retention for ephemeral inference telemetry (30 days) with settings configurable for Dedicated/Private customers. We can provide an SLA addendum for extended retention windows for enterprise plans.

Next steps: 1) confirm you received Drive access, 2) tell us if you need redlines to any attestation language, and 3) if you need an NDA we can have legal issue an access‑only NDA within 24 hours.

Marissa Cole
Principal Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 13:10:00 -0700

Marissa, Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the Drive invite; I can access the folder. A couple of clarifying asks after a quick pass through the CSV/PDF: 

1) For any entry marked "high" in risk_flag, can you add a one‑sentence mitigation summary (e.g., contract clause, data minimization, or encryption-at-rest with customer‑managed keys)?
2) For KMS residency: you note control plane keys are in the US — can you confirm whether any ephemeral inference KV cache encryption keys ever transit outside customer region for batching? This is a hardline question for our privacy team.
3) We need a timeline for providing a signed attestation (template) on log retention terms. Our procurement team requested the attestation before Monday to proceed to legal redlines.

If you prefer a quick call to walk us through the roster and the high‑risk entries, I'm available tomorrow 10–11am PT.

Best,
Amit Shah
Security Program Manager
Arcwell Health

Amit —

Thanks for the detailed review and the call offer. Marissa and I discussed the three follow ups and here's our commitment: 

• High‑risk mitigation notes: Marissa will append one‑sentence mitigations to each flagged row and upload an updated CSV by Monday 2025‑06‑23 10:00 AM PT.
• KMS transit question: Grace confirmed that inference KV cache encryption keys are derived per‑region and are not routed outside of the configured region for Dedicated and Private customers. For Hosted customers, batching may touch cross‑region routing in rare burst scenarios; we will provide a short technical note detailing the network flow and envelope encryption behavior by Monday.
• Signed attestation for log retention: We can provide a draft attestation for signature by Monday EOD UTC; legal has prepped a template we can sign as an addendum for procurement.

I'll set up a 30‑minute walkthrough with you and Grace to cover the high‑risk items and the KMS flow; proposed time Tue 2025‑06‑24 10:00 AM PT — let me know if that works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Drive links and final artifacts will be placed in the folder below (same folder). If you have any urgent needs before Monday ping me directly on my cell.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-Arcwell-evidence

Best,
Ben Carter
